steps.name: And an INFLUENCER user is authenticated for registry tests
When the user performs a registry lookup for NIP "5261040828"
Then the response status should be 409

expected 409; response body: {"timestamp":"2026-11-05T09:11:23.379","status":409,"error":"Conflict","message":"This operation is only available for company accounts","path":"/api/registry/lookup","requestId":"REQ-9698a38d","messageKey":"error.registry.invalid_user_type"}
And the error message should contain "only available for company"
error body must carry the contract message
